headingText: Sec. 407.2. Delivery of a controlled substance to a pregnant woman.

blocks.text: Sec. 407.2. Delivery of a controlled substance to a pregnant woman.

blocks.label: (a)
blocks.text: (a) Any person who violates subsection (a) of Section 401 of this Act by delivering a controlled substance to a woman he knows to be pregnant may be sentenced to imprisonment for a term twice the maximum amount authorized by Section 401 of this Act.

blocks.label: (b)
blocks.text: (b) Any person who delivers an amount of a controlled substance set forth in subsections (c) and (d) of Section 401 of this Act to a woman he knows to be pregnant commits a Class 1 felony. The fine for a violation of this subsection (b) shall not be more than $250,000.
